patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for feature descriptions, often pairing a large number or icon on one side with explanatory text on the other.
Key phrases within prominent headings are consistently highlighted with a vibrant accent color to draw attention and emphasize core concepts.
The site employs a high-contrast dark theme, predominantly using a deep dark teal/green background with a bright, almost neon, lime green accent for calls to action and textual emphasis.
The hero section features a subtle parallax scroll effect on its background image, creating depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections animate into view with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, revealing information progressively.
A dedicated 'Frequently Asked Questions' section utilizes an accordion pattern to present information concisely and allow users to expand details on demand.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-width background image or video with a dark overlay to ensure text readability, combined with a subtle parallax effect where the background scrolls slower than the foreground content.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging CSS keyframes, to fade and slide elements into view as they enter the user's viewport.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the browser window, ensuring constant access to site navigation regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, sans-serif headings (up to ~4x body text) with a distinct accent color for emphasis, paired with a clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on buttons and cards, almost sharp edges overall).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The striking combination of a deep, dark teal/green primary color with a vibrant, almost neon, lime green accent creates a sophisticated yet energetic feel. The consistent use of this accent color to highlight key words within large headings is particularly distinctive, guiding the eye and reinforcing core messages.
